[b][size=4][color=#ff0000]Installation Guide:[/color][/size][/b][/color]

1. Download the Raffadax Complete Production Mod.
2. Download this mod, and unzip it.
3. Drag and drop the folders of this mod into the "zz_Raffadax CP -3.x.x" folder. Replace all files.

If you'd like to uninstall the retexture, just install Raffadax Complete Production again.
